character_fit.label: Fitness proportions
character_fit.reason: The short-arm rest character uses the validated fitness proportions for a loaded conventional floor pull.

contacts.grip_calibration: Source width is uncalibrated; the declared model fit must still pass physical and form checks.

plate_floor.method: evaluated full-size disc mesh components; actual world-space lowest plate vertex in every frame

rows.note: Reach adaptation changes the photographed equipment path.
Conservative shaft/body surface samples; overlap candidates need visual review.
Both lifting elbows must remain at least 175 degrees throughout the rep.
Hip and knee lockout and upright torso must occur at the recorded end phase.
Both full-size weight-disc meshes must be present; a bare bar or decorative rim does not establish a floor pull.
Both actual lowest plate vertices must reach the floor at the recorded start phase.
Actual evaluated plate vertices must stay above the floor throughout every frame.
